verdict: Axon's revenue jumped 28% to a record $909M as its software business grew 43%, and it earned $57M (EPS $0.68) — while announcing a $1.2B investment to raise its stake in drone maker Skydio to 37%.

kpis.label: Revenue
kpis.note: A record, +28% vs a year ago

segments.name: Connected Devices
segments.note: TASER devices, body cameras and drones. Platform Solutions (including drone-as-first-responder) more than doubled to $125M.

segments.name: Software & Services
segments.note: Evidence.com, records and AI tools for police agencies — subscription revenue with 126% net retention, and AI ARR above $100M.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling to police agencies and running the company; includes heavy stock-based pay.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: 21% of revenue — new TASERs, cameras, drones and AI software, including $65M of stock-based compensation.

otherDetail: Other income, net of $60M — largely gains on strategic equity investments — plus $6M of interest income, less $28M of interest expense on convertible notes.

takeaways.title: Record revenue of $909M
takeaways.text: Growth accelerated: software rose 43% and devices 16%, with drones and AI products the fastest-growing pieces.

takeaways.title: A $1.2B bet on drones
takeaways.text: Axon is investing $1.2B more in Skydio, taking its stake to about 37% at a $5.2B valuation, and becomes Skydio's exclusive public-safety distributor in the U.S. and Canada.

takeaways.title: EPS of $0.68, vs a loss last year
takeaways.text: GAAP profit of $57M compares with a $2M loss a year ago; excluding stock-based pay and investment gains, non-GAAP EPS was $1.72.
